Comment.Language: The verse for Archangel Michael is added to the verses of the intercessions before the verse for the angels:

Text.Language: Hiten nip~recbia~ n~te piar,/aggeloc e~youab Mi,a/l p~ar,on n~naniv/oui: P~[oic arih~mot nan m~pi,w e~bol n~te nennobi.
Through the intercessions of the holy archangel Michael the commander of the heavenly: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
بشفاعات رئيس الملائكة الطاهر ميخائيل رئيس السمائيين. ياربُ أنعم علينا بمغفرة خطايانا.
